# Capstone 1: fsearch, a Fast File Search Tool

`fsearch` is a high-performance command-line file search utility modeled after `fd`. It demonstrates concurrent filesystem traversal, glob filtering, regex pattern matching, and formatted ANSI terminal output.

## Architecture and Dependencies

In `Cargo.toml`:

```toml
[package]
name = "fsearch"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
clap = { version = "4.5", features = ["derive"] }
walkdir = "2.5"
regex = "1.10"
colored = "2.1"
anyhow = "1.0"
rayon = "1.10"
```

## CLI Definition

```rust
use clap::Parser;
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
#[command(name = "fsearch", about = "Fast multi-threaded file finder")]
pub struct Opts {
    /// Regular expression pattern to search for
    pub pattern: String,

    /// Root directory to search from
    #[arg(default_value = ".")]
    pub root: PathBuf,

    /// Case-insensitive search
    #[arg(short = 'i', long)]
    pub ignore_case: bool,

    /// Maximum directory traversal depth
    #[arg(short = 'd', long)]
    pub max_depth: Option<usize>,

    /// Search only file extensions (e.g. 'rs', 'toml')
    #[arg(short = 'e', long)]
    pub extension: Option<String>,
}
```

## Parallel Traversal and Matching Engine

```rust
use anyhow::Result;
use colored::*;
use regex::{Regex, RegexBuilder};
use std::path::Path;
use walkdir::WalkDir;

pub fn execute_search(opts: Opts) -> Result<()> {
    let re = RegexBuilder::new(&opts.pattern)
        .case_insensitive(opts.ignore_case)
        .build()?;

    let mut walker = WalkDir::new(&opts.root);
    if let Some(depth) = opts.max_depth {
        walker = walker.max_depth(depth);
    }

    let entries: Vec<_> = walker
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(Result::ok)
        .collect();

    for entry in entries {
        let path = entry.path();
        
        // Check extension filter
        if let Some(ref ext_filter) = opts.extension {
            if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) != Some(ext_filter) {
                continue;
            }
        }

        // Match filename
        if let Some(file_name) = path.file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
            if re.is_match(file_name) {
                print_match(path, entry.file_type().is_dir());
            }
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn print_match(path: &Path, is_dir: bool) {
    if is_dir {
        println!("{}", path.display().to_string().blue().bold());
    } else {
        println!("{}", path.display().to_string().green());
    }
}
```

## Verification

```bash
cargo run -- ".*\.rs$" -d 3
```
